scripts.dev: npm run build:lib && concurrently -n lib,docs -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @openviking/react" "npm run dev --workspace @openviking/ui-docs --"
scripts.lint: npm run check:release-notes && npm run build:lib && node scripts/lint.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:lib && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react/tsconfig.config.json && tsc --noEmit -p docs/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run check:swatches && npm run build:lib && node scripts/test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build:docs
scripts.version:react: node scripts/release-notes.mjs --changesets-only && changeset version && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm run sync:release-notes
